author: GitHub
description: Open source nonprofits have a backlog problem. New features, workflow redesigns, infrastructure migrations — the high-impact work that needs sustained coordination keeps stalling because maintainers are stretched thin and there's no one to carry it through. Project Pods is GitHub's answer: a collaborative space where mission-driven open source projects connect with skilled volunteer teams to ship the big stuff together.
title: Maintainer Month Special: Introducing Project Pods

description:
The terminal is powerful, but if it breaks your development flow, you can manage your entire Git workflow right inside VS Code. The built-in source control panel lets you initialize repositories, stage changes, write commit messages, and push directly to GitHub. This keeps your focus entirely on your code without switching windows. Check out the full walkthrough on our channel to see exactly how it works: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NFjz1AGKA4c
